name: Five Eyes and a Nose — Gaia's Face
insight: 5 eyes: left (iGPU→LG), right (5090→Acer), third (frameGate), fourth/hyoid (Pixel), FIFTH (PIP composite — binocular merge). The organism already IS the sole robot.

right_eye.role: Kenshi, games, Cursor IDE, full GPU render
right_eye.note: RTX 5090 has 2 more DP + 1 HDMI still free

third_eye.role: Gaia's FACE — shows the world to Kevin at House 2
third_eye.note: First ARM SteamOS node. Can receive Steam Remote Play from northGate.

fourth_eye_hyoid.role: FLOATING HYOID — the bone that floats free, untethered to skeleton
fourth_eye_hyoid.status: MOBILE — carried by Kevin between houses
fourth_eye_hyoid.triangulation: WiFi SSID/RSSI determines which house Kevin is in
fourth_eye_hyoid.note: Like the hyoid bone in the human body — the ONLY bone not connected to another bone. It floats in the throat, anchors the tongue. grapheneGate floats between LANs, anchors Gaia's voice.

fifth_eye_pip.status: Available when both GPUs + cables connected
fifth_eye_pip.mode: Picture-in-Picture — BOTH GPU inputs overlaid on ONE panel
fifth_eye_pip.role: COMPOSITE VISION — both eyes merged into one view
fifth_eye_pip.note: PIP = the organism sees BOTH streams simultaneously. Like binocular vision merging into depth perception. Also: Pixel (grapheneGate) can PIP its own apps over the remote stream — mobile composite vision.

fossils_in_monitor_registry.note: Windows remembers monitors that were connected before — these are display fossils
fossils_in_monitor_registry.LG_ULTRAGEAR_GSM7766: Was connected via different port/GPU (now Unknown)
fossils_in_monitor_registry.LG_ULTRAGEAR_GSM7765: Multiple fossils — was on iGPU AND 5090 at different times
fossils_in_monitor_registry.AOC28E850_HDR: FOSSIL — AOC 28" HDR monitor was connected before, not here now

vision_architecture.remote_eye: frameGate — Steam Frame at House 2 (Steam Remote Play)
vision_architecture.floating_eye: grapheneGate — Pixel 8a hyoid (WiFi, carried by Kevin)
vision_architecture.metaphor: Human visual system: left eye (detail/dashboard), right eye (action/game), third eye (remote vision), hyoid (floating proprioception)
vision_architecture.fifth_eye: PIP composite — binocular merge of left+right on one panel

the_nose.anatomy: In a human face, the nose tip sits BETWEEN the two eyes. Both eyes see it. The brain learns to look PAST it. But it's always there — sensing.

browser_as_nose.position: Between left eye and right eye — always in both visual fields
browser_as_nose.smells: RSS, web, OSINT, Forgejo, GitHub, Steam Workshop, Reddit, arxiv
browser_as_nose.breathing: The eyeBall ghost pulses at 25% opacity — like nasal breathing, unconscious but vital
browser_as_nose.behavior: Brain filters it out (inattentional blindness) but peripheral attention catches changes

the_nose.insight: The nose SMELLS — it takes in the world (RSS, web, OSINT). The eyes SEE — they render the world (games, dashboards). The nose sits between the eyes and the brain learns to look PAST it, but it's always sensing. The browser IS the nose. It smells the web. It sits between the two GPU eyes. You see past it to the game, but it's always there, always pulling data IN through the water lock.
the_nose.what: The BROWSER is Gaia's 3rd eye — the tip of the nose

mapping.nose_3rd_eye: BROWSER — floats between both displays, always visible, always sensing
mapping.left_eye: iGPU → LG ULTRAGEAR (119Hz) — dashboard, map, telemetry
mapping.pip_5th: PIP composite — binocular merge, depth perception
